description: Pre-trade risk verdict on a Base token, $0.01. Give a Base contract address and get: honeypot/transfer-simulation result, buy and sell tax, mint and owner privileges, verified-source status, blacklist and pausable flags, liquidity and holder concentration, scored 0-100 with the explicit red flags named. Aggregated live from honeypot.is, DexScreener, GoPlus and GeckoTerminal. Run it before buying, approving or LP-ing an unknown token.

address.description: Base mainnet token contract address (0x + 40 hex chars)

since.description: Optional: the watch.change_token from a previous token_verdict call. When supplied, the response reports only the fields that moved since that snapshot (changed: [{field, from, to}], unchanged: true/false) plus a fresh change_token - so an agent can poll this as a pre-trade gate without diffing.

name: token_verdict
